preconditions.description: The input text must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'sludge' if (has_water_trigger(text) and has_slime_trigger(text)) else ('water' if has_water_trigger(text) else ('slime' if has_slime_trigger(text) else 'air'))
postconditions.description: Returns 'sludge' if both water and slime triggers are present, 'water' if only water triggers are present, 'slime' if only slime triggers are present, and 'air' if neither are present.

postconditions.expression: has_water_trigger(text) == any(w in text.lower() for w in ['water', 'wet', 'wash'])
postconditions.description: A water trigger exists if any of the base words 'water', 'wet', or 'wash' appear as substrings in the lowercased text.

postconditions.expression: has_slime_trigger(text) == any(p in text.lower() for p in ['i don\'t know', 'slime'])
postconditions.description: A slime trigger exists if either the phrase 'i don't know' or the word 'slime' appears as a substring in the lowercased text.
